name: Financial Crisis
description: Money's getting tight. The battle checks aren't covering what they used to.

chapters.title: Bills Due
chapters.description: Rent's due and you're short. Your last few battle checks went to other things. Now you need money fast.

choices.label: Take a Quick Battle
choices.description: There's a small room battle paying quick. Low stakes, fast money.

choices.label: Ask for an Advance
choices.description: Hit up your league. See if they'll front you on the next battle.

choices.label: Find a Side Hustle
choices.description: Pick up some other work. It'll take time from prep.

chapters.title: The Advance
chapters.description: They gave you the advance. But now they own your next check. And they want you to take a battle you don't want.

choices.label: Take the Battle
choices.description: You need the money. Fight whoever they say.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.description: You'll find another way to pay them back.

chapters.title: Under Their Thumb
chapters.description: You took their battle. Now they're talking about 'exclusive contracts' and 'long-term deals'. This is getting tight.

choices.label: Sign the Deal
choices.description: Stable money. Less freedom. It's a trade-off.

choices.label: Break Free
choices.description: Pay them off however you can and get out.

chapters.title: Debt Collector
chapters.description: The league is pressing you for that advance money. They're threatening to blacklist you.

choices.label: Pay It Back
choices.description: Scrape together the money. Sell something if you have to.

choices.label: Negotiate
choices.description: Work out a payment plan. It'll take longer but it's manageable.

endings.title: Quick Money
endings.description: You handled it. Took a battle below your level but the lights stayed on.

endings.title: Side Hustle Life
endings.description: You got another source of income. Less time for battles but more financial security.

endings.title: Contract Bound
endings.description: You signed an exclusive deal. Steady pay but limited options.

endings.title: Free Agent
endings.description: You paid off the debt and stayed independent. It was expensive but worth it.

endings.title: Debt Free
endings.description: You paid back every cent. Your name is clean.

endings.title: Payment Plan
endings.description: You're paying it off slowly. It's hanging over you but it's manageable.
